title: Refine requirements from prototype feedback
statement: As a change author, I can connect prototype states to evolving stories, so that user-visible discoveries refine requirements without losing their history.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An author can add a self-contained interactive prototype.
An author can add a supported external prototype link.
A prototype annotation links one identifiable part of the experience to a story or criterion.
Changing the linked prototype marks its annotation stale.
Changing the linked requirement marks its annotation stale.
An unlinked prototype appears as an optional documentation gap.
